Triangle3DExact.definition: Non-degenerate 3D simplex defined by 3 vertices (v0, v1, v2) with Float64 coordinates

Segment3D.definition: Continuous finite 3D line segment S(t) = P1 + t*(P2 - P1), t in [0, 1]

Capsule3D.definition: Minkowski sum of finite 3D line segment and 3D sphere of radius R >= 0
